description: Helper functions and types for handling Telegram messages, threads, and routing within a bot framework, including thread resolution, reply description, and group/peer ID building.

classes.name: TelegramThreadSpec
classes.description: Type defining the structure for thread specifications, including optional ID and scope (dm, forum, none).

methods.name: extractTelegramForumFlag
methods.description: Extracts the 'is_forum' boolean flag from an unknown value object.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumFlag
methods.description: Asynchronously determines if a chat is a forum based on chat ID, type, and getChat function.

methods.name: withResolvedTelegramForumFlag
methods.description: Preserves or sets the 'is_forum' flag in a message's chat object.

methods.name: resolveTelegramGroupAllowFromContext
methods.description: Resolves group allow permissions and configurations for a Telegram chat, considering forum/thread context.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumThreadId
methods.description: Determines the thread ID for forum groups, defaulting to general topic ID if unspecified.

methods.name: resolveTelegramThreadSpec
methods.description: Builds a thread specification object based on group, forum, and message thread ID.

methods.name: buildTelegramThreadParams
methods.description: Constructs API parameters for message threading, omitting general topic ID (1).

methods.name: buildTelegramRoutingTarget
methods.description: Creates a routing string that includes real thread IDs for reply handling.

methods.name: buildTypingThreadParams
methods.description: Builds thread parameters for typing indicators, including message_thread_id.

methods.name: resolveTelegramStreamMode
methods.description: Resolves the stream mode configuration for Telegram, defaulting via preview stream mode.

methods.name: buildTelegramGroupPeerId
methods.description: Builds a peer ID string for a Telegram group, including thread ID if present.

methods.name: resolveTelegramDirectPeerId
methods.description: Determines the direct peer ID for Telegram DMs, preferring sender ID if available.

methods.name: buildTelegramGroupFrom
methods.description: Constructs a group peer string from chat ID and optional thread ID.

methods.name: buildTelegramParentPeer
methods.description: Builds a parent peer object for forum topic inheritance, based on group and thread ID.

methods.name: buildGroupLabel
methods.description: Creates a label for a group message, including title and thread info.

methods.name: resolveTelegramReplyId
methods.description: Normalizes a reply message ID from raw string input.

methods.name: describeReplyTarget
methods.description: Generates a detailed reply target object from a message, including body, sender info, and forwarded context.
